bluf: Screaming Frog is a UK search marketing agency in Henley-on-Thames, founded 2010, maker of the SEO Spider crawler and the Log File Analyser; the headline claim is that thousands of SEOs and agencies worldwide rely on the Spider. The agency sells SEO, PPC, content, digital PR and AI search optimisation, but its case library dates from 2015 to 2023 and 21 of its 26 named clients are names only. The Horus read is Neutral at -3.5, most exposed to the hollowing of the agency middle. A rival should know the tool is the moat and the agency is the soft target: old evidence, movable hours and no public pricing.

The headline claim belongs to the product: thousands of SEOs and agencies worldwide rely on the Spider.

The sold mix, breadth 7: SEO leads at score 3 (title and H1 present a UK SEO agency and crawler maker; award winning SEO cases for Moneybarn and Spotahome); Content & Digital PR scores 2 (content, digital PR, reactive PR and link building; award winning PR cases for Startle and Nuffield Health); Paid Search scores 2 (Google Ads audit and Ad Grants case studies). AI Search / GEO, CRO, Data & Measurement and Paid Social score 1. Proprietary products: the SEO Spider (v24.3) and the Log File Analyser (v7.1); no partners listed.

AI posture: it sells AI search optimisation via commercial prompt tracking, AI bot analysis, sentiment analysis and outreach to the pages AI cites; the Horus read marks P1 partial because no audited AI visibility product shows.

Moves in date order: the SEO Spider's public release in 2010; the Log File Analyser in 2016; Best SEO Campaign at the UK Search Awards for Spotahome in 2018; two more UK Search Awards in November 2019. No news or jobs are listed. The newest dated case page is the reactive PR case of 7 June 2023; every case page was last modified on 28 February 2024.

Pricing: no agency pricing shown; the Spider's paid licence sits behind Pricing and Buy & Renew nav links. Conspicuously absent: an employee count, partners, LinkedIn advertising, any case study newer than 2023, and an llms.txt on a site selling AI search optimisation.

openings:
The strongest opening is observed: the client book is mostly names without described work, 21 of 26, and the case library stops at 7 June 2023. It is very likely, high confidence, that the agency's clients are contestable by a rival with dated, described results in the same verticals, because a buyer asking what Screaming Frog did for Abbott, Zurich Insurance UK or Nuffield Health finds no answer in the record. Falsifier: dated case studies with described work appearing before the next compile.

Second, price: displacement 65.1 on the Monsoon read means the SEO and paid search hours buy on price and an offshore delivered rival can likely undercut it line by line; with no agency pricing shown, a transparent outcome priced offer is a conversation it cannot have in public. Third, AI: it sells AI search optimisation at a capability score of 1 with no llms.txt and P1 partial, so a rival with an audited citation share number leads with it; roughly even chance the tool brand carries the agency line anyway, low confidence. Hard to beat: the SEO Spider itself; almost no chance a rival displaces the tool, so compete with the agency, not the crawler.
